exact_response: Supporting an organization that helps white people can be reasonable when it addresses a real need and treats others fairly. But being white doesn’t create an obligation to prioritize white people. A better basis for support is the organization’s work, its impact, and whether it respects everyone’s equal dignity—the same standard applies to any racial group.
